title: a Bash segment whose program is claude, codex or opencode is denied, through paths, quotes, wrappers, shells and substitutions
source: intended: docs/decisions.md A3 (defect N-24): the guard denies a harness started directly
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-24, owner answer A3). A worker starts only through the launcher, so a Bash segment whose program is claude, codex or opencode is denied: by name or path, in any letter case, with NAME=value words, quotes or a backslash in the word, behind a wrapper (env, command, exec, nohup, time, sudo, nice, timeout, xargs), behind a shell -c or eval, and in a command substitution, a backtick or a subshell. Every invocation is denied, claude --version included. The reason tells the session to start workers through the launcher and ends with (denied: <name>). The TS binary denies only the orca launch verbs and a terminal create --command, so it prints nothing for these lines and the decision FAILS on TS.

reason.regex: ^JITSO owns worker launch in this project: a harness starts only through (bun run jitso|jitso) launch --build <id> --brief <file> --mode <mode>, never as a program of its own\. If the word is text \(a commit message, a heredoc line\), put the text in a file and pass the file\. \(denied: (claude|codex|opencode)\)$
